title: Structure-Guided Proteogenomics Identifies ARID1A-Associated cBAF Protein Co-variation in Lung Cancer — code and data, v1.1.1
description: Reproducibility materials for a structure-selected ARID1A-associated cBAF protein co-variation analysis in lung cancer. Includes exact analysis inputs, code, derived results and an unpublished manuscript. Observational protein co-variation is not whole-panel synthetic lethality. See README for dataset-specific licenses and replay instructions.
